description: SVG and PNG links to a version, not the image, with hashes and engine version. A published diagram's links last until it's made private or deleted (url is its page); others, 7 days. preview adds a PNG. Artifacts, slides and PDFs need the png file itself. scene or mermaid instead of id previews an unsaved diagram.

asOf.description: 2026-06-30 (end of day, UTC) or ISO 8601 with an offset

mermaid.description: erDiagram or flowchart (graph); drops subgraphs, edges to them and styles
